items.body: The government receives money in the following ways. Which one is a revenue receipt?

options.text: Corporation tax collected from firms, which the government never has to return
A loan raised by issuing bonds that the government must repay on maturity
Money borrowed from a foreign government, to be repaid with interest
Funds raised through securities that are redeemable after a fixed period

excerpts.text: Revenue Receipts: Revenue receipts are those receipts that do not lead to a claim on the government. They are therefore termed non-redeemable. They are divided into tax and non-tax revenues.

items.body: The RBI sells government bonds worth Rs 500 crore in the open market to private individuals and institutions. According to the NCERT discussion of open market operations, what is the effect of this sale?

options.text: Reserves in the economy increase, so the money supply rises
Reserves in the economy fall, but the money supply is not affected
Neither reserves nor the money supply change, since only the ownership of bonds changes
Reserves in the economy fall, so the money supply is reduced

excerpts.text: When RBI buys a Government bond in the open market, it pays for it by giving a cheque. This cheque increases the total amount of reserves in the economy and thus increases the money supply. Selling of a bond by RBI (to private individuals or institutions) leads to reduction in quantity of reserves and hence the money supply.

items.body: In an economy the marginal propensity to consume is 0.75. If autonomous investment rises by Rs 40 crore, by how much does equilibrium income rise?

excerpts.text: In an economy without a government, the ex ante aggregate demand for final goods is the sum total of the ex ante consumption expenditure and ex ante investment expenditure on such goods, viz. AD = C + I.

items.body: Under a fixed exchange rate system, the government changes the official exchange rate from Rs 75 per dollar to Rs 80 per dollar, so that one dollar now costs more rupees. According to the NCERT definitions, this government action is called:

excerpts.text: This exchange rate is determined by the market forces of demand and supply. It is also known as Floating Exchange Rate .

Similarly, in a flexible exchange rate regime, when the price of domestic currency (rupees) in terms of foreign currency (dollars) increases, it is called Appreciation of the domestic currency (rupees) in terms of foreign currency (dollars).

In a fixed exchange rate system, when some government action increases the exchange rate (thereby, making domestic currency cheaper) is called Devaluation. On the other hand, a Revaluation is said to occur, when the Government decreases the exchange rate (thereby, making domestic currency costlier) in a fixed exchange rate system.

items.body: A bank is required to keep 20 per cent of its deposits as reserves. If the bank holds reserves of Rs 300 crore, what is the maximum amount of deposits that these reserves can support?

excerpts.text: Since the bank is only expected to keep 20 per cent of its deposits as reserves, thus, reserves of Rs 100 (20per cent of 500 = 100) can support the deposits of Rs 500.

Therefore, we can conclude that as long as marginal revenue is greater than marginal cost, profits are increasing. By the same logic, as long as marginal revenue is less than marginal cost, profits will fall. It follows that for profits to be maximum, marginal revenue should equal marginal cost. items.body: A simple consumption function is C = 80 + 0.6Y, where C and Y are in Rs crore. Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Even when income is zero, consumption is Rs 80 crore
When income is zero, consumption is also zero
Rs 80 crore is the level of consumption that is independent of income
The term 0.6Y is the autonomous consumption, since it changes at a constant rate

excerpts.text: The simplest consumption function assumes that consumption changes at a constant rate as income changes. Of course, even if income is zero, some consumption still takes place. Since this level of consumption is independent of income, it is called autonomous consumption.
